visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian man sits on a green metal railing on a busy street in Bangkok, wearing a light purple school shirt, dark tie, and black shorts. He smiles warmly at the camera. In the background, cluttered power lines, Thai storefronts, and a red motorbike are visible under bright natural daylight. (2) The man walks with a female companion, both in school uniforms; he rests his arm on her shoulder as they move down a sidewalk. The camera tracks them from behind, showing architectural details of urban buildings and parked scooters. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of a small clothing shop where many school uniforms hang from the ceiling and walls. A handwritten price chart and measuring tools are visible on a glass counter. The man stands while a young girl uses a pink measuring tape to measure his waist over a colorful duck-patterned shirt. (4) The group of four friends poses together in uniforms against various backdrops, including a white ornate wall and a closed metal shop shutter with colorful graffiti. They exhibit playful facial expressions and hand gestures like the peace sign. (5) The group is seen eating at an outdoor food stall; they use metal spoons to eat from pink bowls filled with soup and noodles. One man holds a smartphone to record the moment. The lighting is bright and the atmosphere is casual.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 今天帶你來泰國曼谷穿制服. (2) [Subtitle]: 泰國高中生. (3) [Subtitle]: 一個人是害羞 一群人是青春. (4) [Logo]: 瑪荷店. [Subtitle]: 位於曼谷考山路的瑪荷店. [Slogan]: 整套制服 480 泰銖起. (5) [Subtitle]: 會依照大小還有長短調整價格. (6) [Subtitle]: 1000 內基本上沒有問題啦 (畢竟我穿到3XL). (7) [Subtitle]: 還可以客製化繡上自己的泰文姓名. (8) [Subtitle]: 會送上領帶還有蝴蝶結. [Subtitle]: 店家還會幫忙整理一下頭髮喔. (9) [Subtitle]: 現在要依照那個尺寸來量我們制服的費用. (10) [Subtitle]: 可是他說布料越多的話那個價格是會越高的高. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以有可能一件兩萬 XD (愛開玩笑). (12) [Subtitle]: 我們就這樣穿著高中制服走在路上. [Subtitle]: 邊走邊拍 隨便都能出片. (13) [Subtitle]: 多久沒有跟朋友這樣一起瘋一波呢. [Subtitle]: 那就趁現在吧. (14) [Variety]: (背後突襲擁抱). [Variety]: (沒反應?!). [Variety]: 不能談戀愛! [Variety]: 啊!. [Variety]: (處理工作還要被鬧XD). [Variety]: 教官來了!. (15) [Subtitle]: 恥度很高的一整天. [Subtitle]: 在唐人街吃粿條. [Subtitle]: 還在路上邊走邊拍. (16) [Subtitle]: 有一種高中放學不想補習的感覺. [Subtitle]: 把握和朋友的時間一起熱血一次吧. (17) [Subtitle]: 出社會之後要交朋友越來越不容易. (18) [Subtitle]: 尤其是有時候真的很懶得把不同族群的朋友湊在一起. (19) [Subtitle]: 畢竟聊的不一樣 生活圈不一樣 工作也不一樣. (20) [Subtitle]: 但是總有些緣分可以把同樣頻率的人集合在一起. [Slogan]: 快點 Tag 你的好朋友一起來泰國穿制服吧.
